Parents who choose Abthi usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: ابثی
in_urdu.meaning: اردو کی ایک اسم جو حکیمانہ اور علم کے معنی میں آتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابثی ایک قدیم اردو اسم ہے، جو حقیقت اور علم کی علامت ہے۔ یہ اسم اپنے عربی اصل سے ہے، اور اسے اسلامی ناموں میں استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ اسم پاکستانی مسلمانوں میں بھی مقبول ہے، اور اسے ایک مشرف نام سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

He was among those who embraced Islam during the Prophet's (pbuh) early mission in Mecca before the Hijra (migration) to Medina. He was also one of the Muhajirun (emigrants) who migrated to Medina with the Prophet (pbuh) in 622 AD. Abd Thabit (ra) was known for his bravery and steadfastness in Islam, and he participated in many battles alongside the Prophet (pbuh).
historical_references.context: Embraced Islam early in Mecca, Muhajirun (emigrant) to Medina, participated in battles alongside Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)

historical_references.reference: Abu Thabit al-Muhallabi, a companion of the fourth rightly-guided Caliph, Ali ibn Abi Talib (ra), was a prominent figure during the Battle of Siffin (657 AD). He was a supporter of Ali (ra) and was known for his piety and devotion to the cause of truth and justice. During the Battle of Siffin, Abu Thabit (ra) commanded the right wing of Ali's army. He was later martyred during the battle, becoming a Shuhada (martyr) for the cause of truth and justice.
